uiValidation.description: Lengths count Unicode code points; minLength<=maxLength; required cannot have maxLength0. Incomplete initial/editing values allowed; actions with validate are blocked atomically if a field fails.

uiMenuItem.description: Host enforces globally unique menu IDs, 128 menu/action items total and depth 4.

uiDataSource.description: Directory source reads current pane memory snapshot only, default pageSize64. transferTask reads the extension-owned latest controlled transfer, default/pageSize1, no filter/sort. State keys must be declared; output keys distinct from each other and input/selection keys.

detail.description: Second caption line under the label; the row grows to 40 DIP.

group.description: Top-level only. Caption of a tinted item group (selection-gradient band with caption and gear); consecutive items with the same caption share the band.

primary.description: Semibold label for the group's main action.

uiPreviewMenuItem.description: Preview menu item for menuPreview nodes; commands are optional and separator items may omit text.

$comment: Shared UiTree semantic constraints, not a JSON/native execution transport. Native model data_source/context bindings/data operations remain UNAVAILABLE. pulse.ui.data separately binds providers to existing empty model data nodes; see api-catalog.
